name: devforge
description: DevForge skills for coding agents: turn a Jira issue into a developer-ready markdown spec

interface.shortDescription: Turn a Jira issue into a developer-ready markdown spec
interface.longDescription: DevForge converts a Jira issue — Bug, Story, Task, Spike, or Epic — into a structured markdown spec a developer can act on, filling in acceptance criteria, edge cases, security and performance flags, dependencies, and definition of done, and clearly marking everything it inferred.
defaultPrompt: Turn ABC-123 into a markdown spec.
Here's a Jira ticket description — make it developer-ready.
